description: The headline latency fixture: a transcript large enough to force head+tail truncation at RUN_ASSETS_MAX_INPUT_CHARS (48000) and drive worst-case prefill on a CPU host. The harness SYNTHESIZES the body from this compact spec (no 50KB blob in git). Anchor sentences are planted in the FIRST and LAST segments so a faithful summary can still surface them after the middle is truncated away.

synthesize.head_anchor: This is the opening session of the Marisol Vega Coastal Resilience Forum, and today's focus is managed retreat.
synthesize.tail_anchor: To close, the Marisol Vega Forum will reconvene next spring to review progress on managed retreat.
sentence_pool: The panel discussed how rising sea levels are reshaping planning decisions along low-lying coastlines.
Several delegates argued that early investment in wetlands buffers pays for itself within a decade.
One recurring theme was the difficulty of funding relocation for communities that do not want to move.
The moderator noted that insurance markets are already repricing risk faster than local budgets can adapt.
A delegate described a pilot program that raised roads and rebuilt culverts ahead of the next storm season.
The conversation turned to data sharing between municipalities and the gaps in current monitoring networks.
Participants agreed that public communication remains the hardest part of any managed retreat proposal.
The session ended with a call for clearer national guidance and more predictable long-term funding.
